actions.append_to_conversation.descripti: Send a follow-up message in an existing conversation (Beta).
actions.append_to_conversation.props.con: The conversation id (usually starts with conv_), from Start Conversation or List Conversations.
actions.cancel_batch_job.description: Stop a queued or running batch job.
actions.cancel_batch_job.props.job_id.de: The batch job UUID, from Create Batch Job or List Batch Jobs.
actions.complete_code_fim.description: Generate the code that belongs between a prefix and an optional suffix with a Codestral model.
actions.complete_code_fim.props.model.de: A Codestral model id. Fill-in-the-middle only works with Codestral models.
actions.complete_code_fim.props.prompt.d: The code that comes before the part to generate.
actions.complete_code_fim.props.stop.des: Stop generating when any of these strings is produced.
actions.complete_code_fim.props.suffix.d: Optional code that comes after the part to generate.
actions.create_agent.description: Create a Mistral agent with a model, instructions and tools (Beta).
actions.create_agent.props.built_in_tool: Mistral-hosted tools the agent may use.
The system prompt the agent follows in every conversation.
actions.create_agent.props.library_ids.d: Library UUIDs (from List Libraries) the agent can search for answers.
actions.create_agent.props.model.descrip: Chat model id the agent runs on, e.g. mistral-medium-latest.
actions.create_batch_job.description: Start a batch inference job over many requests.
actions.create_batch_job.props.input_fil: UUIDs of .jsonl files uploaded with purpose batch. Each line needs a custom_id and a body.
Optional JSON object stored with the job.
actions.create_batch_job.props.model.des: Model id to run every request with, e.g. mistral-small-latest.
Instead of files, a JSON array of requests, each {"custom_id": "...", "body": {...}}.
actions.create_chat_completion.descripti: Ask a Mistral model a question and get its answer.
actions.create_chat_completion.props.max: Longest reply in tokens, about 4 characters each.
actions.create_chat_completion.props.mod: The Mistral model that writes the reply.
actions.create_chat_completion.props.pro: What you want the model to answer or do.
actions.create_chat_completion.props.ran: Set a seed to make repeated calls return the same output.
actions.create_chat_completion.props.tem: From 0 to 1.5. Lower is more focused, higher is more varied.
actions.create_chat_completion.props.tim: Milliseconds to wait for a response. Empty: 30 seconds.
actions.create_chat_completion.props.top: From 0 to 1. Adjust this or Temperature, not both.
actions.create_embeddings.description: Turn a list of texts into vectors with the mistral-embed model.
actions.create_embeddings.props.input.de: Each text gets its own vector from the mistral-embed model.
Milliseconds to wait for a response. Empty: 30 seconds.
actions.create_library.description: Create a document library for agents to search (Beta).
Characters per chunk when splitting documents, between 256 and 32768. Leave empty for the default.
User keeps the library private; Workspace shares it with your workspace.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_agent.props.agent_id.desc: The agent id (usually starts with ag_), from List Agents.
actions.delete_conversation.props.conver: The conversation id (usually starts with conv_), from Start Conversation or List Conversations.
actions.delete_file.props.file_id.descri: The file UUID, from List Files.
actions.delete_library.description: Permanently delete a document library and all its documents (Beta).
The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.
actions.delete_library_document.descript: Permanently remove a document from a library (Beta).
actions.delete_library_document.props.do: The document UUID, from List Library Documents or Upload Library Document.
actions.delete_library_document.props.li: The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.
actions.download_file.description: Download the content of an uploaded file.
actions.download_file.props.file_id.desc: The file UUID, from List Files or a batch job’s output file.
actions.generate_chat_completion.descrip: Generate a reply from a Mistral chat model given a system prompt and a list of messages.
actions.generate_chat_completion.props.m: Maximum number of tokens to generate.
The conversation so far, oldest first. The last message is usually from the user.
Chat model id, e.g. mistral-large-latest or mistral-small-latest. Use List Models to see what your key can access.
actions.generate_chat_completion.props.r: Set a seed to make repeated calls return the same output.
Choose JSON to force the model to return a valid JSON object. Also ask for JSON in the prompt.
actions.generate_chat_completion.props.s: Optional instructions that set the model behaviour for the whole reply.
actions.generate_chat_completion.props.t: Sampling temperature between 0 and 1.5. Mistral recommends 0 to 0.7.
actions.generate_speech.description: Turn text into a spoken audio file.
Name for the audio file, without extension.
actions.generate_speech.props.voice_id.d: A preset voice slug such as en_paul_neutral, en_paul_happy or en_paul_sad, or the UUID of a custom voice.
actions.get_agent.description: Get the configuration of a Mistral agent (Beta).
actions.get_agent.props.agent_id.descrip: The agent id (usually starts with ag_), from List Agents.
actions.get_agent.props.agent_version.de: Return this version instead of the current one.
actions.get_batch_job.description: Check the status and results of a batch job.
actions.get_batch_job.props.inline.descr: Include the results in the response instead of only an output file id. Only for small jobs.
actions.get_batch_job.props.job_id.descr: The batch job UUID, from Create Batch Job or List Batch Jobs.
actions.get_conversation.description: Get the details of a stored conversation (Beta).
actions.get_conversation.props.conversat: The conversation id (usually starts with conv_), from Start Conversation or List Conversations.
actions.get_conversation_history.descrip: Get every entry of a conversation, including tool calls (Beta).
actions.get_conversation_history.props.c: The conversation id (usually starts with conv_), from Start Conversation or List Conversations.
actions.get_conversation_messages.descri: Get the user and assistant messages of a conversation (Beta).
The conversation id (usually starts with conv_), from Start Conversation or List Conversations.
actions.get_document_status.description: Check whether a library document has finished processing (Beta).
actions.get_document_status.props.docume: The document UUID, from List Library Documents or Upload Library Document.
actions.get_document_status.props.librar: The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.
actions.get_document_text_content.descri: Get the text Mistral extracted from a library document (Beta).
The document UUID, from List Library Documents or Upload Library Document.
The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.
actions.get_file.description: Get the details of an uploaded file.
actions.get_file.props.file_id.descripti: The file UUID, from List Files or Upload File.
actions.get_file_signed_url.description: Get a temporary link to download an uploaded file.
actions.get_file_signed_url.props.expiry: How long the link stays valid, between 1 and 168 hours.
actions.get_file_signed_url.props.file_i: The file UUID, from List Files.
actions.get_library.description: Get the details of a document library (Beta).
actions.get_library.props.library_id.des: The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.
actions.get_library_document.description: Get the details of a document in a library (Beta).
actions.get_library_document.props.docum: The document UUID, from List Library Documents or Upload Library Document.
actions.get_library_document.props.libra: The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.
actions.get_model.description: Get details and capabilities of one Mistral model.
actions.get_model.props.model_id.descrip: The model id, e.g. mistral-large-latest or a fine-tuned id starting with ft:.
actions.list_agents.description: List the Mistral agents in your organization (Beta).
actions.list_agents.props.page_token.des: The next page token from a previous call.
actions.list_agents.props.search.descrip: Only return agents whose name or id contains this text.
actions.list_files.description: List files uploaded to your Mistral account.
actions.list_files.props.purpose.descrip: Only return files uploaded for this purpose.
actions.list_files.props.search.descript: Only return files whose name contains this text.
actions.list_libraries.description: List document libraries you can access (Beta).
The next page token from a previous call.
actions.list_libraries.props.search.desc: Only return libraries whose name contains this text.
actions.list_library_documents.descripti: List the documents in a library (Beta).
actions.list_library_documents.props.lib: The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.
actions.list_library_documents.props.sea: Only return documents whose name contains this text.
actions.list_models.description: Retrieves a list of available Mistral AI models.
actions.moderate_chat.description: Check a conversation for harmful content.
actions.moderate_chat.props.messages.des: The conversation to check, oldest first.
actions.moderate_text.description: Check one or more texts for harmful content.
actions.moderate_text.props.texts.descri: One or more texts to check. Each is scored separately.
actions.reprocess_document.description: Run text extraction and indexing again for a library document (Beta).
actions.reprocess_document.props.documen: The document UUID, from List Library Documents or Upload Library Document.
actions.reprocess_document.props.library: The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.
actions.restart_conversation.description: Branch a conversation from an earlier entry with a new message (Beta).
actions.restart_conversation.props.conve: The conversation id (usually starts with conv_), from Start Conversation or List Conversations.
actions.restart_conversation.props.from_: The entry to restart from, from Get Conversation History.
actions.restart_conversation.props.messa: The new user message to send from that point.
actions.run_ocr.description: Extract the text of a PDF or image as Markdown.
actions.run_ocr.props.documentSource.des: Where the PDF or image to read comes from.
actions.run_ocr.props.includeImageBase64: Also return the images found in the document, as base64.
actions.run_ocr.props.model.description: Latest is recommended. Version 2505 never changes.
actions.run_ocr.props.pages.description: Page numbers to read, starting at 0. Empty: every page.
actions.run_ocr.props.timeout.descriptio: Milliseconds to wait for a response. Empty: 2 minutes.
actions.start_conversation.description: Start a stored conversation with a Mistral agent or model (Beta).
actions.start_conversation.props.agent_i: Run this agent (from List Agents). Leave empty to talk to a model directly.
actions.start_conversation.props.instruc: System instructions, only used when talking to a model directly.
actions.start_conversation.props.model.d: Model id to use when no agent is given, e.g. mistral-medium-latest.
actions.start_conversation.props.store.d: Keep the conversation on Mistral so it can be continued later.
actions.transcribe_audio.description: Convert speech in an audio file to text with a Voxtral model.
actions.transcribe_audio.props.diarize.d: Label which speaker said each segment.
actions.transcribe_audio.props.file.desc: The audio file to transcribe. Leave empty if you use Audio URL or File ID.
actions.transcribe_audio.props.file_id.d: UUID of an audio file already uploaded to Mistral (see List Files).
Public URL of the audio file.
Two-letter language code of the audio, e.g. en or fr. Leave empty to auto-detect.
actions.update_agent.description: Change a Mistral agent’s name, model, instructions or tools (Beta).
actions.update_agent.props.agent_id.desc: The agent id (usually starts with ag_), from List Agents.
actions.update_agent.props.built_in_tool: Mistral-hosted tools the agent may use.
actions.update_agent.props.library_ids.d: Library UUIDs (from List Libraries) the agent can search for answers.
actions.update_library.description: Rename a document library or change its description (Beta).
The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.
actions.update_library_document.descript: Rename a library document, set its attributes or an expiry date (Beta).
actions.update_library_document.props.at: Custom key-value attributes as a JSON object. Replaces the existing attributes.
actions.update_library_document.props.do: The document UUID, from List Library Documents or Upload Library Document.
actions.update_library_document.props.ex: The document is deleted automatically after this date.
actions.update_library_document.props.li: The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.
actions.upload_file.description: Upload a file to Mistral for OCR, batch jobs or fine-tuning.
actions.upload_file.props.file.descripti: The file to send to Mistral, up to 512 MB.
actions.upload_file.props.purpose.descri: What Mistral may use the file for. Fine-tuning needs a .jsonl file.
actions.upload_library_document.descript: Add a document to a library (Beta).
actions.upload_library_document.props.fi: The document to add, e.g. a PDF, DOCX or text file.
actions.upload_library_document.props.li: The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.
